purpose: Separate editorial publications and long-form publishing destinations from social networks, communities, research repositories, and data sources.

sourcePreservation.originalSeed: Preserve the user-provided initial 17-destination list as recorded in docs/PLATFORM-REGISTRY.md and src/data/platforms.ts.
sourcePreservation.note: The remaining original entries are retained in the existing general platform registry and are not reclassified as magazines.

destinations.name: Medium
destinations.editorialProfile: Long-form article with clear thesis, readable structure, original perspective and appropriate publication selection.
notes: Not a traditional magazine accepting pitches through a central editorial desk.
Check account and publication-specific rules before submission.

destinations.name: Substack
destinations.editorialProfile: Recurring editorial voice, strong subject line/title, reader relationship, and newsletter-aware introduction.
notes: Requires access to the target publication/account.
Do not assume public API publishing is available.

destinations.name: WordPress
destinations.editorialProfile: Structured CMS article with title, slug, body, taxonomy, featured image, excerpt, SEO fields where supported.
notes: WordPress is a CMS, not a single magazine.
Each target site must be registered and authorized separately.

destinations.name: Blogger
destinations.editorialProfile: Blog-style article with clear headings, labels, images, and source links.
notes: A blog host rather than an editorial magazine.
OAuth and blog-level permissions required.

destinations.name: Ghost
destinations.editorialProfile: Magazine/newsletter article with editorial metadata, tags, feature image, excerpt, and publication state.
notes: Each Ghost publication is a separate destination and needs its own credentials.

destinations.name: LinkedIn Articles
destinations.editorialProfile: Professional argument, evidence, implications, and practitioner insight.
notes: Also appears in the social registry; long-form article handling remains distinct from feed-post adaptation.
Do not assume API support for long-form article publishing.

destinations.name: HackerNoon
destinations.editorialProfile: Original technical story with practical detail, a clear point of view, substantiated claims, and relevant technical visuals.
notes: Candidate added for technology-focused editorial submissions.
Acceptance and current submission workflow must be checked before each campaign.

destinations.name: DZone
destinations.editorialProfile: Technical article with actionable implementation detail, code/examples where relevant, and expert review.
notes: Candidate added for technical articles, not general brand promotion.
Confirm current contributor program and editorial rules.

destinations.name: The Gulf Magazine
destinations.editorialProfile: Original reporting, sourced analysis or evidence-backed opinion relevant to Gulf readers; disclose conflicts and provide author bio and source links.
notes: The publication states that an editor reviews submissions and publishes accepted work; submission is not guaranteed publication.
Do not automate submission until the user approves the exact pitch/article and disclosures.

destinations.name: DAWN Prism
destinations.editorialProfile: Original feature or analysis with a clear regional relevance, careful sourcing, short author bio, and separately supplied image captions and credits.
notes: DAWN asks contributors not to submit the same piece simultaneously to multiple desks or other newspapers.
Publication follows editorial review; no guarantee.

destinations.name: I by IMD
destinations.editorialProfile: Well-grounded, thought-provoking and actionable insights for leaders; proposal must precede a full article draft.
notes: The publication explicitly requests a formal proposal first and does not review unsolicited full drafts without proposal approval.

destinations.name: +972 Magazine
destinations.editorialProfile: Original reporting, analysis or opinion with a distinct insight, transparent sourcing, and clear explanation of why the story matters now.
notes: The magazine asks for a pitch explaining significance, reporting plan, access and expertise.
Editorial review and acceptance are required; do not auto-publish.

excludedFromMagazineAutoPublishing.reason: Community discussion platform; not a magazine submission destination.
Question-and-answer platform; not a general article submission destination.
Specialist Q&A communities; answers must directly solve questions.
Encyclopedia with neutrality, notability, sourcing and conflict-of-interest requirements; not a promotional publishing destination.
Research preprint repository with scholarly eligibility requirements; not a press or marketing magazine.
Biomedical literature repository; not a general editorial submission outlet.
Code and project hosting; not a general magazine.
Web archive/data source; not a publication destination.
